reviews.title: Great mic at a great price!
reviews.comment: My microphone on my headset had finally broken after a few years and I was in need of a replacement. My friend recommended one of the generations of the Razer Seiren microphone and it was an easy-buy! And I still feel that way after a few weeks of owning it! It was super simple to set up (one cable) the sound quality is a sincere improvement from my headset mic (all my friends said so after hearing me) and it’s quite sensitive to outside noise and blocks it really well. It has a simple mounting process (you screw it into the base and set it in your desk) and I have zero issues with durability. Finally, the simple touch mute on the surface is perfectly consistent and at that price it was almost an insta-buy! Great value on a great product!
reviews.author: Easton

reviews.title: Amazing and cute
reviews.comment: It's lightweight and small enough to fit on my small desk. It was easy to set up and has amazing sound quality. You can't control things like sensitivity or volume, but there is a function to mute the mic. The mute button is sensitive sometimes, but at other times, you have to tap it a few times to get it to actually work. It worked with both my Chromebook and desktop. The color is really pretty and matches well with my setup.
reviews.author: Kylie

reviews.title: good, clear sound quality for a cute mini desktop mic
reviews.comment:
a great quality, cute, small desktop microphone. I primarily use it on discord calls and for work zoom calls, and I’ve been told that the voice quality it provides is clear & crisp.
I like the small size so it doesn’t take up much space on my desk, plus the pink color matches nicely with my set up!
The top has a touch-to-mute feature which is convenient, and it’s not too sensitive to the touch so you won’t accidentally mute/unmute.
I bought this on a black friday sale deal for $35 or so. It’s marked as $59.99 originally and I’d say that price is more expensive than I’d be willing to pay, so I’m glad I was able to get this item on sale!

reviews.title: Cool
reviews.comment: Very good microphone with great quality for the price. The mute button on top is really convenient, and  because of that it’s hard to put the fluffy covers without covering the mute button It’s lightweight, comfortable, and very easy to set up.
reviews.author: Alayla

reviews.title: Good sound quality but get a USB-C extender, the cord it comes with is way too short
reviews.comment:
I have had this Razer Seiren V3 mini for a couple months now. It works great and is crystal clear. However, I recommend getting some sort of mic stand/swivel to put this on. This mic has to be pretty close to your mouth for your voice to be received well. I use this mic for gaming and do not do any streaming or anything. It is perfect if you want to have separate headphones & mic setup. It is INCREDIBLY small which is its greatest feature.
The USB-C cord that this comes with is far too short for anything in my opinion. Look at replacing the USB-C cord with a longer one OR getting a USB extender (I recommend 10'). I went the extender route and it works great. If you want to put this right on your desk, you might be OK. However if you are going to put this on a swivel or stand you will absolutely need to pick up a longer cord or extender!
On the note of swivels/stands - one minor annoyance is that for some reason, it has a hard time screwing into swivel/stands. The thread design that Razer uses might be proprietary or something. My mic does screw in, but it isn't secure and it will fall off if I mess around with the mic too much. I used the proper adapters, it seems to be something with Razer threads.
All in all, If you want to use this for streaming - I would say upgrade to something more streamer friendly. This won't cut it for you. However, if you just want a desk mic to chat with buddies while gaming or to use during work, this is perfect for you. But make sure to get a USB extender! You will thank me later!
